context_requirements: Expression of one or more phospholipase targets (PLCB2/3, PLCD1, PLCG1/2, PLA2G1B) or downstream signaling components.
Intact GPCR or receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to provide substrate/PIP2 and calcium.
Functional PKC/NFAT/NF-kB or MAPK/AP-1 pathways for transcriptional output.
For PLA2G1B activation: lipid substrate availability and intact arachidonic acid cascade.
falsifiers: No induction of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) or NF-kB targets (NFKBIA, CXCL2, IL1B) at 6 h in any responsive line.
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h.
Uniform absence of any transcriptional response across all nine lines.
Strong and specific induction of unfolded protein response or heat shock genes without inflammatory/AP-1 signature.
